why: The book prints the toroid field as mu0 N i/(2 u R): an italic Latin u where pi belongs. The line above (2 pi r0) and the flux line below (mu0/2pi) both carry 2 pi, and r0 ~ R gives mu0 N i/(2 pi R). Typographic only; L = 2.414e-3 H is unaffected.

The printed working substitutes the solenoid length as 20 x 10^-4 m. The stem gives l = 20 cm = 20 x 10^-2 m, and the printed L = 0.1257 mH follows only from 0.20 m (4pi e-7 x 200^2 x 5e-4 / 0.20 = 1.2566e-4 H); with 20e-4 m the same expression gives 12.57 mH.
